data.content_ref: inline:Extend the closure rule along the warrant's support chain: an attack on any support node at depth d inherits as an attack on the warrant's target, but only if the chain is broken at that point (all intermediate nodes attacked or absent), capped at depth D. Enforce entirely in att construction, label-free, so the edge operator stays monotone and the fixpoint's kind is unchanged. Polynomial via the depth cap; deterministic as a pure function of the graph; reinstatement remains derived inside Pass 1. This makes support-chain fragility visible to the extension — a warrant whose evidence chain is undermined anywhere becomes attackable — while preserving committed-root validity because inheritance only ever adds attacks, never acceptance. The trap: inheritance can create self-attack cycles; prove acyclicity via provenance ordering plus the depth cap.
